scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run build:backend && node scripts/application.mjs dev
scripts.build:backend: npm run build --prefix packages/domain && npm run build --prefix packages/contracts && npm run build --prefix packages/workspace && npm run build --prefix packages/model-gateway && npm run build --prefix packages/agent-runtime && npm run build --prefix packages/persistence && npm run build --prefix apps/platform-server
scripts.check:web: npm run typecheck --workspace @atoms-builder/web && npm run lint --workspace @atoms-builder/web && npm run format:check --workspace @atoms-builder/web
scripts.verify: npm run db:up && npm run db:test:init && npm run build && npm run check:web && npm run test:web && npm run test:contract && npm run test:model && npm run test:local && npm run test:deploy-config && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:restart
scripts.build:local: npm run build:backend && npm run build:web
scripts.build: npm run build:local && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:contract: npm run build --prefix packages/domain && npm run build --prefix packages/contracts && tsx --test tests/contract/*.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:contract && npm run test:evals && npm run test:deploy-config && npm run test --prefix packages/workspace && npm run test --prefix packages/model-gateway && npm run test --prefix packages/agent-runtime
